Title: Windows 7 and Windows 8.1 client VM images are now available for MSDN subscribers

Body.Content:
Virtual machine images for Windows 7 and Windows 8.1 are now available in the Azure virtual machine gallery. MSDN subscribers now have the flexibility to utilize an on-demand dev/test environment for their client-targeted app, leveraging the elasticity and scale of Microsoft Azure.

To get started, log in to the Azure Management Portal and create a new Virtual Machine.
